judge.rationale: The candidate ignored multiple explicit requirements and design decisions in the ticket, inventing its own frame and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionListMessage` / `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the specified `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationListMessage` / `ConversationSummary`. It completely omitted the required `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config (making the feature always enabled) and the new `UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, directly contradicting an explicit requirement and acceptance criterion in the issue, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store does not implement `listFor` instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame. It also hand-edited `docs/getting-started.md` instead of updating `example/full-config.ts` and running `docs:fix`, and allowed `limit: 0` or `> 200` in validation rather than restricting `limit` to 1–200.
